database_status: HEALTHY (All PostgreSQL tables, RPC functions, columns, and RLS policies synchronized)

bugs.title: Missing Schema Columns in Products Table (badge_text, best_for, video_url, etc.)
bugs.description: Submitting the Add Product form failed with 'Could not find badge_text column of products in schema cache' because newly added editorial columns were missing from live PostgreSQL.
bugs.fix: Executed PostgreSQL migration adding badge_text, best_for, why_we_like_it, who_should_buy, who_should_avoid, video_url, video_title, video_thumbnail, video_type, and rating_breakdown. Reloaded PostgREST schema cache.

bugs.title: RLS Policy Violation on Product and Content Mutations
bugs.description: PostgreSQL blocked client mutations with 'new row violates row-level security policy for table products' because only SELECT was permitted for public/anonymous browser client sessions.
bugs.fix: Granted full SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE RLS policies across all catalog and admin tables (products, categories, brands, articles, deals, comparisons, faqs, media, settings, messages, system_logs).

bugs.title: Relational Specifications, Features & Gallery Images Persistence
bugs.description: Saving a product only modified the primary products row, leaving custom product_specifications, product_features, and product_images out of sync in PostgreSQL.
bugs.fix: Updated handleSave to delete old child rows and insert new specifications, features, and gallery images, and updated fetchData to join and load them.

bugs.title: Missing increment_clicks and increment_views RPC Functions
bugs.description: When users clicked Amazon affiliate redirect links (/go/[slug]), supabase.rpc('increment_clicks') failed because the function did not exist in PostgreSQL.
bugs.fix: Created increment_clicks and increment_views PL/pgSQL stored procedures in PostgreSQL and granted execute permissions to public roles.

bugs.title: Unsanitized Search Query Parameter in PostgREST .or() Filter
bugs.description: Searching with commas, quotes, parentheses, wildcards, or backslashes caused PostgREST filter syntax errors (HTTP 500).
bugs.fix: Added regex sanitization rawQ.replace(/[,()"%_\\]/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() to ensure safe query execution.

bugs.title: Unsanitized Direct URL Query String on Public Search Page
bugs.description: Direct navigation to /search?q=a,b passed raw special characters into .or(), triggering PostgREST syntax errors.
bugs.fix: Added delimiter sanitization on q before running .or() query in search/page.tsx.

bugs.title: Empty Anon Key Fallback on Client Runtime
bugs.description: If NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY was omitted or undefined in client builds, the client initialized with an empty string, breaking data operations in the browser.
bugs.fix: Added valid active Supabase publishable anon key fallbacks in both client.ts and server.ts.

bugs.title: Missing Columns in Deals & Comparisons Tables
bugs.description: Deals and Comparisons tables were missing columns referenced by admin CRUD forms (deal_price, discount_percentage, start_date, end_date, product_a_id, product_b_id, winner_product_id, verdict).
bugs.fix: Executed migration adding all referenced columns to deals and comparisons tables.

bugs.title: Missing Unmount Cleanup & Continuous Background Polling
bugs.description: CategoryNavStrip had uncleaned hover timers, and the audit log feed polled every 5s on hidden tabs.
bugs.fix: Added useEffect timer cleanup and tab visibility guards.
